title: Discussion on the Physics Problem of a Boat Crossing a River
summary: This study addresses the boat river-crossing problem under non-uniform flow velocities by constructing three models: constant flow (Model 1), linear distribution (Model 2), and even-power function distribution (Model 3, adjustable via parameter n ). By using the vector addition, combined with the solutions of calculus and differential equations, the analytical expression of the ship's spatial trajectory under a fixed heading angle relative to the water flow is derived.
